notes.title: Third-Person Combat Mode Now Live!
notes.content:
NEW FEATURE ALERT – Tactical Warfare Just Got Personal!

We’re excited to introduce one of the biggest gameplay updates yet: Third-Person Combat Mode! For the first time in Tactical Warfare, you can leave the top-down view behind and step right into the action by controlling your RTS units from a third-person perspective.

Key Features:

- in-Field Action– Control tanks, planes, ships, and more in third-person shooter mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44829480/6f64c15a723b8e3e95527ac209108e036dc97d63.gif

 - Build & Fight – Continue managing your base and producing units while in TPS view.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44829480/98b1552864da441441da968624146c3f7836678d.gif

- On-Field Commanding – Control and switch between other units directly from the field.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44829480/17a4f5f1f2fe3a890f91792f088b643d6900c448.gif

- No Base Mode (New Game Mode) – Focus purely on strategy and combat. No buildings. No resource collection. Just tactics and action with a fixed income, and it is Available in Skirmish (Offline) and 1v1 Multiplayer (Online)

This update blends real-time strategy with immersive field combat like never before.

Got Feedback?
Share it with us here or join the conversation on Discord.

See you on the battlefield, Commander!

notes.title: Update on Tactical Warfare Release Date
notes.content:
Dear Tactical Warfare community,

We have an important update regarding the release of Tactical Warfare. While we initially announced a launch date of November 29, we’ve made the tough decision to delay the release to ensure the best possible experience for you. The new release is planned for the end of December, with a specific date to be announced soon.

Thank you for your understanding, and stay tuned for more updates. We’re committed to delivering a game that meets your expectations!

Warm regards,
The Tactical Warfare Team
